content: Liquid gradient on interactive UI: Logo/brand uses double-layer gradient+glass overlay. Buttons use animated rotating gradient borders (Framer) or shader-powered liquid metal (hover/click ripple, GPU-accelerated). Avatars use animated rotating conic/linear gradient border with hover glow. Active nav states use content-aware liquid glass. Data viz blends chart bg with page bg, highlights via local transparency changes, smooth transitions. iOS 26 Liquid Glass language: gradient bg + semi-transparent glass, fine shadow borders, backdrop-blur. WebGL liquid bg with cursor-driven distortion is common for hero/landing.
